pf2e-exploration-activities.Title: Exploration Activities
pf2e-exploration-activities.SettingsHint: The GM opens an activity request or posts a fresh chat invitation. Re-launching an open request preserves choices.
pf2e-exploration-activities.ChatInvitation: The GM invites the party to choose exploration activities.
pf2e-exploration-activities.SelectCharacter: Click a character to set or change their activity.
pf2e-exploration-activities.GMOnly: Only the GM can launch activity selection.
pf2e-exploration-activities.EmptyParty: The active Party has no characters.
pf2e-exploration-activities.DuplicateAssignment: A character is assigned to multiple users
pf2e-exploration-activities.Unavailable: Activity selection is closed. The GM must start a new request.
pf2e-exploration-activities.Resolving: The last request is still rolling.
pf2e-exploration-activities.NoRights: You may choose only for your assigned character.
pf2e-exploration-activities.MedicineTrainingRequired: Trained Medicine proficiency is required for Treat Wounds.
pf2e-exploration-activities.HealingHint: The native PF2e apply-healing chat button requires the patient's token to be selected on the scene.
pf2e-exploration-activities.NoRepairableItems: No accessible PF2e physical items; add one to a character or Party inventory.
pf2e-exploration-activities.MissingItem: Item not found or no longer accessible.
pf2e-exploration-activities.RollErrors: Some checks could not be performed
pf2e-exploration-activities.SomeRollsFailed: Some checks failed; a private GM message has details.
